## Product description
Elevate your look with this stunning Lotus model Korean chain and earrings set from MITHRAS CANADA. Inspired by the timeless beauty of traditional Indian jewellery, this exquisite set features an intricately designed lotus-shaped pendant adorned with vibrant ruby-red and clear kundan stones, complemented by a rich emerald-green centrepiece. The pendant hangs gracefully from a delicate gold-toned Korean chain, secured with an adjustable clasp for a comfortable fit. The matching stud earrings mirror the pendant's design, showcasing the same stunning lotus motif with cascading golden beads that add a touch of elegance and movement. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, this jewellery set is perfect for weddings, festivals, and special occasions. The warm gold-toned finish beautifully complements a wide range of traditional and contemporary outfits, from sarees and lehengas to fusion wear. Whether you're dressing up for a celebration or looking to add a touch of heritage-inspired glamour to your ensemble, this Lotus model set is a truly captivating choice.
